name: Dagan
source:
“The Stalker Neighbour”

Wera's mysterious next-door neighbor who has a nasty habit of going from one girl to another. His persistent and cheery personality has the tendency to make Wera uncomfortable; however, this doesn't stop him from pestering her to no end.
